user.title: Custom Hygrostat

data.name: Name
data.startup_delay: Maximum wait for inputs at HA startup (s, 0 = regulate immediately)
data.error_template: Error condition (template, true = stop, empty = ignored)
data.device_entity: Dehumidifier entity (driven by the hygrostat, and source of the internal sensor)
data.power_switch: Power switch (optional: power-cycles the device when it stops responding)
data.power_sensor: Outlet power (optional: no power cycle if the device draws nothing)
data.probe_host: Device IP address (optional: reachability probe before cutting power)
data.probe_port: Probe port (6668 for a Tuya module)
data.plug_only: Plug-only control (off-network device, left in forced mode)
data.stall_watts: Stall threshold (W): below this draw the device is doing nothing
data.stall_delay: Stall delay (s): start-up time allowed, and how long low draw must last
data.fan_entity: Device fan (optional, to drive the speed)

error.humidity_range: Minimum humidity must be lower than maximum.
error.self_reference: This is the hygrostat's own entity: point to the appliance, not to its regulator.
error.fan_entity_required: A fan speed template requires selecting the fan entity.
error.target_required: The setpoint is required: a template, for instance {{ 55 }}.
error.power_switch_required: This setting only decides a power cycle: set the power outlet first
error.power_switch_required_plug_only: Plug-only control has nothing to command without a power outlet
error.power_sensor_required_plug_only: Without a power reading there is no way to tell whether the device runs
error.unexpected_in_plug_only: This entity belongs to an off-network device: leave the field empty
error.device_entity_required: Set the dehumidifier entity, or tick plug-only control

abort.already_configured: A hygrostat with this name already exists.
